questions.question: Spec grill R1a — family-breadth boundary: 'Allow curl ⇒ curl with anything' is clear for network/read tools. Should the SAME family breadth apply to destructive binaries (rm, dd, git push --force, sudo…), or do those stay exact-argv/per-ask?
options: Family only for a safe list

questions.question: Spec grill R1b — does killing the 'Setup needed' message also apply to NON-tool blockers (missing credential, capability install, channel setup) that today carry grantable setup actions on that card?
options: Yes — one card for all needs (Recommended)
questions.chosen: Yes — one card for all needs (Recommended)
